title: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists a topographic range of 20.4 km
summary: The fact sheet lists Earth's topographic range as 20.4 kilometers.
body: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists a topographic range of 20.4 kilometers. The sheet does not, on that line, name the highest and lowest points that make up the range. This card does not add those names.

sources.title: Earth Fact Sheet
sources.author: David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, NSSDCA
